title: [30 rc1] AAPS shows double down arrow at 283 and increasing delta value.
symptom: Although the blood glucose level is rising, two downward arrows are displayed in the AAPS interface. In addition, when entering carbohydrates, the message 'Bolus cannot be delivered' is displayed and you can only stop the action. An input via the bolus calculator with carbohydrates has worked.
cause: The issue is identified as an xDrip problem.
evidence_quote: I read last week same issue and if you see that it's a Xdrip problem .
